name: Download Residues & Incomplete Stream Sanitizer
author: WinCare Core Team
description: Detects and purges abandoned multi-part streams (.crdownload, .part, .aria2, .dap) and fragmented torrent residues.

tools.title: Incomplete Download Stream Debris
tools.summary: Removes stalled partial downloads (.crdownload, .part, .aria2) older than 7 days from user download directories.

tools.title: P2P Torrent & Metadata Debris
tools.summary: Purges orphaned .torrent metadata fragments and incomplete fastresume cache files.

tools.title: Multi-Part Chunk & Archive Debris
tools.summary: Detects and purges stalled multi-part download chunks (.cpdm.part, .dlman.part, .abdm.part, .qdm, .gopeed, .motrix) and orphaned archive segments.
